html:
Iogys is a map label for a people of the western Gran Chaco, at the meeting of Salta, Argentina, and Tarija, Bolivia. The name seems to be a form of Iyojwa'ja, the name the Chorote use for themselves, though little else is recorded under this spelling.

The Chorote speak a Mataco language and are neighbours of the Wichí (Weenhayek), the Nivaclé and the Tapieté. They lived by fishing in the Pilcomayo River, gathering wild fruit and hunting, and later worked seasonally in sugar plantations of Argentina.
